title: A bi-Lipschitz piece F(B) has approximate tangent space range DF(b) at F(b) for a.e. b ∈ B
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, F : ℝ^n → ℝ^P L-Lipschitz, B ⊆ ℝ^n Borel and m > 0 with m|a − a′| ≤ |F(a) − F(a′)| for all a, a′ ∈ B, and suppose F is differentiable with injective derivative DF(b) at every b ∈ B. Then for Lebesgue-almost every b ∈ B, range DF(b) is the approximate tangent space of F(B) at F(b) in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (F(B)) (F(b)) (range DF(b))).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L F → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ F a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ F a)) → ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (F '' B) (F b) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F b : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
